title: What is an EPO health plan?
summary: Explains how an EPO plan works, gated vs non-gated EPOs, advantages, comparison with PPO, and dental EPOs.

atoms.title: What is an EPO health plan?
atoms.question: What is an EPO plan?
atoms.text: An EPO plan is a common type of health insurance that requires care from a certain network of providers. Generally, EPO insurance covers out-of-network care only in emergencies or special circumstances, like during complex treatment or if the EPO network does not have the type of provider needed. A person will likely have a higher deductible and lower monthly payments than with other types of health plans.
questions: Does an EPO cover out-of-network care?

atoms.title: What does EPO stand for?
atoms.question: What does EPO stand for?
atoms.text: EPO means exclusive provider organization. The name refers to the rule of staying within the plan's network of select providers. If a person gets care outside the EPO network, they will likely have to pay the full cost of that visit.
questions: What happens if I go outside my EPO network?

atoms.title: An EPO combines features of HMOs and PPOs
atoms.question: How does an EPO work?
atoms.text: EPOs can be thought of as a combination of HMO and PPO plans. Like a PPO, most EPO plans offer the freedom to see any network provider without a referral and typically do not require choosing a primary care provider (non-gated plans only). Without a PCP sending referrals, a person may have to get preapproval for certain services. Like HMOs, EPOs do not offer out-of-network coverage.
questions: How is an EPO like a PPO?

atoms.title: Gated vs. non-gated EPO plans
atoms.question: What is the difference between a gated and non-gated EPO plan?
atoms.text: With a gated EPO plan, a person will typically need a referral from a PCP to see a specialist. With a non-gated EPO plan, generally no referral is needed to see specialists, if the provider is in the network. A person should check the specifics of their plan's benefits to learn whether referrals are needed before seeing a specialist.
questions: Do I need a referral with a non-gated EPO?

atoms.title: Advantages of an EPO plan
atoms.question: What are the advantages of an EPO plan?
atoms.text: EPO insurance offers some benefits like those of PPO and HMO plans, such as flexibility and lower costs. Advantages include no referrals needed (non-gated plans only), usually no requirement to choose a primary care provider, and generally lower out-of-pocket costs than a PPO plan. An EPO may suit someone who wants to choose providers without referrals while staying within the network.
questions: What are the pros of an EPO?

atoms.title: EPO vs. PPO plans
atoms.question: What is the difference between an EPO and a PPO?
atoms.text: One major difference is that unlike PPO plans, EPO plans do not offer coverage for out-of-network care. Because of that limitation, EPO plans usually have lower out-of-pocket costs than PPO plans. On referrals, an EPO needs none if the plan is non-gated, and a PPO needs none. On choosing a primary care provider, an EPO usually does not require it and a PPO does not.
questions: What's the difference between EPO and PPO?
Which has lower costs, EPO or PPO?

atoms.title: Do I need a referral with an EPO?
atoms.question: Do I need a referral with an EPO?
atoms.text: Typically, EPO insurance gives a person the freedom to see any network provider without a referral, which can make getting care simple and convenient. However, with gated EPO plans, a person may need to get referrals from their PCP. They should check their specific plan benefits to see if a referral is needed before seeing a specialist.
questions: Can I see a specialist on an EPO without a referral?
Do I need a referral on a non-gated EPO plan?

atoms.title: What is a dental EPO plan?
atoms.question: What is a dental EPO plan?
atoms.text: EPO dental plans work just like EPO health plans. Generally, a person can see any dental provider in their EPO network without a referral, but should check plan details to be sure. Getting dental care outside the plan's network will cost more, possibly the whole bill.
questions: Do dental EPO plans need referrals?
